answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow blocks bulk fake identities. A newcomer locks 60 credits, released only while its fingerprint stays coherent. The fingerprint pairs the pulse of action timing with the meter of its phrasing, a sonnet pattern scripts cannot copy at scale. Release thaws at a glacier pace, one tranche per honest epoch. The named failure is fingerprint rental: live timing never matches the rented record, so the deposit is slashed. The kth fake still needs its own 60 credits and history, so 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 credits; an honest agent locks 60 once.
